name: WayriCAD Review
description: Saved-design reviews with PCB/schematic views, comment markers and GitHub/GitLab conversations.
description_full: Navigate saved PCB, schematic and PCB 3D views with a separately supplied KiView renderer. Add point/region drafts and inspect published comment markers in matching saved revisions. Includes a visual user guide, compact light/dark workspace, browser device-code sign-in and absolute eight-hour desktop sign-out. Comments uses GitHub/GitLab general issue/PR/MR conversations; Discussions uses real GitHub GraphQL discussion threads. Provider comments remain authoritative; drafts stay local until explicitly sent. The renderer has separate licensing and is not bundled. Native schematic selection, native overlays and inline diff reviews are unsupported. Testing package; direct OAuth live approval, connected KiCad 11 and Linux/macOS GUI acceptance remain unverified.
